answer: Memory-hard salted puzzles: every identity must publish an Argon2id solution using 1 GiB of RAM, salted with its public key and the epoch beacon, and each solution takes about 30 seconds. Identities that share a funding source form a cluster, and the cluster's puzzle memory doubles per extra member, so the tenth fake from one wallet needs 512 GiB, like a reef growing a new terrace each tier. Validators verify a solution with one hash check against the zenith of the public beacon, so cheating cannot be hidden.
